notes: Two master volume sliders join the header: VOICE VOL trims everything the nets play (your per-net VOL knobs still work underneath it), and 1MC VOL independently sets how loud clips are piped — the fleet hears that level, and so does your own monitor, which deliberately ignores VOICE VOL so turning voice down can't hide what you're broadcasting. Ship rows also stop lying about their own state: a ship with LSN ALL or the 1MC live used to say '0/6 NETS' — counting subnets you'd individually tuned, which ships don't need — so a fully-up ship read as dead; it now says 'ALL 6 NETS' in green. The stray lone number after that counter (the head-count of the ship's container channel, where nobody ever sits) is gone. And clip names keep their apostrophes — BOATSWAIN'S CALL, not BOATSWAIN_S CALL.
